summary: Completed testing of Rhino.fi bridge integration for TRON -> SOLANA routes. Backend API fully working - bridge quote endpoint returns valid quotes with quote_id, amounts, fees, and estimated time. Network toggle (Mainnet/Testnet) working correctly. Token selection modal opens and displays chains/tokens. Known UI bug persists: clicking TRON chain in 'View all' modal fails due to nested dialog overlay issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking TRON chain in 'View all' modal fails - nested dialog overlay intercepts pointer events
ui_bugs.note: This is a known issue from iteration 4. Users cannot select native TRON chain tokens through the 'View all' modal.

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/bridge/quote returns valid Rhino.fi quote for TRON -> SOLANA USDT -> USDC
Backend: Quote includes quote_id, from_amount, to_amount, fee_usd, gas_fee_usd, estimated_time_seconds
Backend: GET /api/bridge/configs returns TRON and SOLANA in supported_chains
Backend: GET /api/bridge/provider correctly routes TRON/SOLANA to 'rhino' provider
Backend: Non-TRON routes correctly suggest LI.FI
Backend: Invalid addresses return appropriate error response
Backend: LI.FI chains and tokens endpoints working
Frontend: Network toggle switches between Mainnet and Testnet
Frontend: Token selection modal opens with chain filter and search
Frontend: 'View all' button shows all chains including TRON
Frontend: Wallet connection modal shows MetaMask, Phantom, Trust Wallet, TronLink
failed_tests: Frontend: Clicking TRON chain in 'View all' modal - overlay intercepts clicks (known issue)
action_items: Fix ViewAllChainsModal: nested Dialog overlay intercepts pointer events when clicking chain buttons
Consider using a single Dialog with conditional content instead of nested Dialogs
critical_code_review_comments: Rhino.fi integration is working correctly - JWT authentication, quote fetching, and error handling all functional
Network toggle state management working properly with environment variable in walletStore
ViewAllChainsModal nested Dialog issue persists from iteration 4 - needs architectural fix

success_rate.frontend: 90% (network toggle, token modal, wallet modal all working; TRON chain selection blocked by known bug)

seed_data_creation: Test transaction created via API testing with Rhino.fi route_provider

Network toggle (Mainnet/Testnet) works.
